title: Evan D NDE 416/22863
content:
22863: I was driving to work at night and it was sleeting and raining heavily. I was running late and was speeding. I was driving at one hundred miles per hour when I hit the brakes too hard to take a corner. I ran off the road and struck two marker posts on the side of the road. Then everything went black. I then was out of my body floating above the car looking down at myself slumped forward in the driver’s seat, I was bleeding heavily from cuts on my head and for a few moments was transfixed watching myself bleed to death. I felt the greatest peace I have ever known and fell nothing but goodness flowing around me. Although it was pitch black and raining, I could see clearly because there was a bright light behind me (I was twenty-five kilometers from the nearest light source, I was on a country road). Then my whole life flashed before me on fast forward. I saw myself being born then it would pause a little at every major event that had happened to me. It seemed to take only a second or two from start to finish. Then a voice said to me ‘Do you want to live or die.’ By the tone of the voice, it was saying to make up my mind quickly or else I wouldn't have a choice. I thought about how sad my family would be if I died so I said ‘Live’ and I was instantly back in my body. I got out of the car, walked up to the road, and got a lift to my workplace where I was immediately sent to hospital. But apart from a lot of cuts and bruises, I wasn't badly hurt. I was released from hospital after two days of observation. I was told later that it looked like the car had flipped end over end three times, landed on the roof then rolled over onto its wheels. When I went and saw the car in daylight, I was shocked at the amount of damage done to the car. The roof was pushed down so low I couldn't get in the car and sit in the driver’s seat

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death | Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death Car crash.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was floating about two to three meters above my body looking down; I didn't have another body it's as if only my mind was there. | Yes I was out of my body and looking at myself. I have never felt so warm and peaceful in my life. It was like I was there watching someone else.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Very high. I had never known such a feeling of peace and well-being. | Very alert maybe more than normal.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: No | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning This is difficult to explain. Time seemed to slow down but everything seemed to be happening at once, that's the best I can explain it. Space was normal.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Only the voice asking me if I wanted to live or die. | No noises of any sort, even though it was raining. Only the voice asking me if I want to live and that was in my mind not from outside my body.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: No | Uncertain A voice spoke to me.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes There was a very bright light, lighting the scene up like daylight. It was behind me and I didn't turn to look at it. Probably lucky I didn't over wise I might have gone to it. | Yes There was a bright light behind me but I did not turn and look at it.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Every sense was at the highest level. | No
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Extreme well-being and peacefulness and no pain whatsoever. | Beautiful warmth and peacefulness with no pain.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control | My past flashed before me, out of my control It was like on a screen in my mind running at very high speed. I don't really know if I learnt anything that I didn't already know. It happened so quickly that it was hard to focus on any one bit of it. It seemed that I was just getting a quick general view of my life.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I chose life and was immediately back in my body. | I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was asked whether I wanted to live or die. I am sure that if I would have chosen death I would have bled to death in the car. I lost a lot of blood.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I chose life and was immediately back in my body. God, Spiritual and Religion | point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was asked whether I wanted to live or die. I am sure that if I would have chosen death I would have bled to death in the car. I lost a lot of blood. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: No Although the experience set me on the path toward metaphysics. | Yes I fully believe in life after death now. I wasn't sure before.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Although the experience set me on the path toward metaphysics. After the NDE | change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I fully believe in life after death now. I wasn't sure before. After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: No I did discover metaphysics after that while looking for an explanation as to what happened to me. | Yes The voice that spoke to me has stayed with me and advises me what to do all the time. I have found that if I don't follow the advice then usually I am 'forced' to follow it or something bad happens.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best was that wonderful feeling I got being out of my body. The worst part is wondering whether I did the right thing in choosing life. But when I look at my wonderful wife, I say yes, I did the right thing. | The best was the beautiful feeling of warmth and peace. The worst was going back to my body I often wish I had taken death.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Only on rare occasions, I get too much flak over it. | Yes I have only told people like you about my experience. Ordinary people just don't believe me.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes I have left my body one time after the experience and one time before it when I was a child. | Yes I left my body again about eight years later, see above. But it was not anything like the first one.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I have had two other out of body experiences but not near death, I just left my body.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: You seem to have it all covered.
